method.scope: Every live flagship whose lifecycle stage was ratified at capture time.
method.claim_rule: A served sustained or not_yet_adopted claim is safe only under a current first-class post-ratification coverage receipt.
method.zero_rule: Zero usage is an observed zero only under the same current coverage gate; missing or stale coverage is unscanned.
method.refresh_decision: No redundant observation was filed while every receipt remained current; the scheduled scanner remains responsible for the next reading.
